purpose: A starter summarisation prompt with an annotated source. Replace it with your own sources.
template:
Summarise the following report in under 120 words, as connected prose.

The Lisbon distribution centre began using handheld scanners in January 2026. Before the change, a picker walked an average of 14 kilometres per shift; afterwards, 9 kilometres. Picking accuracy rose from 97.1 per cent to 99.4 per cent. Miguel Antunes, the centre's operations lead, attributes most of the accuracy gain to the scanner refusing a scan that does not match the pick list, rather than to the shorter walk. The centre employs 240 people.
